meta.title: Baxter County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Baxter County's 2026 budget as adopted by the quorum court (Ordinance 2025-55), shown through the county's January 2026 budget report. We use the 'Orig Budget' column. The county moves money between its own funds: $12,625,000.00 is budgeted as 'Transfers Out', and those dollars are counted again in the funds that receive and spend them.
